exact_fact: NEXs Tokyo describes itself as a community connecting startups, large firms, local governments and support institutions across Japan, explicitly leveraging Tokyo's concentration of information and human networks and providing a Tokyo/Marunouchi community space.
limitation: NEXs Tokyo is one candidate central ecosystem, not proof that every regional hub uses the same core.

exact_fact: The Tokyo consortium is organized around dense central Tokyo startup/VC/corporate concentrations and connects surrounding research cities through a hub-and-spoke architecture.
limitation: The first-period geography is Tokyo-region focused rather than nationwide.

exact_fact: The official description emphasizes information, expert networks, events, partners and mutual connections as the source of value for regional and Tokyo startups using the central community.
limitation: It supports network-value plausibility but does not estimate a structural beta.

exact_fact: Matching concierges, partners, mentors, information sharing and connection opportunities are explicit member benefits.
limitation: No causal estimate that each additional participant raises utility linearly.

source_title: 首都圏における官民共創イベント企画・運営委託業務
exact_fact: Ehime states that E:N BASE activities will be taken to the metropolitan area to strengthen networks between E:N BASE members and metropolitan companies and create mutual collaboration.
limitation: This evidence points toward complementarity/linkage rather than direct crowd-out of the core; it does not establish diversion.

source_title: あたらしい愛媛の未来を切り拓くDX実行プラン
exact_fact: Ehime explicitly describes digital, metropolitan and planned in-prefecture co-creation hubs as three hubs to be utilized in promoting public-private co-creation.
limitation: Portfolio design is more consistent with complementarity than single-homing substitution.

exact_fact: The DIVE course is designed for regional startups to use the metropolitan ecosystem for business acceleration, while JUMP connects Tokyo startups to regions.
limitation: Directly weakens a literal claim that local ecosystems necessarily substitute for Tokyo participation. Partial substitution in finite founder time remains plausible but unmeasured.

exact_fact: Membership is searchable across all Japanese regions, including Shikoku, and the same programme/community is offered to startups based outside Tokyo.
limitation: Common programme access is not identical to identical effective outside options for every firm.

limitation: Heterogeneous sector-specific networks may mean firms do not all share the same effective core.

limitation: Physical location and local relationships make cross-regional use more costly, but tau is not directly measured.

exact_fact: Setouchi-i-Base is a physical Takamatsu open-innovation facility with coworking, events, coordinators and business matching; it aims to draw people and firms from inside and outside Kagawa.
limitation: The facility is deliberately broad-area, so administrative borders are not absolute barriers.

exact_fact: Ehime made a discrete institutional/facility commitment to open E:N BASE in May 2026 and commissioned continuous accompaniment/support functions.
limitation: Actual intensity and capacity are continuous after opening; binary entry is a reduced-form approximation.

limitation: Same reduced-form caveat as E:N BASE.

source_title: Do we go shopping downtown or in the 'burbs?
exact_fact: Consumers allocate shopping across a downtown marketplace and peripheral mall; marketplace size creates a network effect through variety and a large mall can hollow out downtown retail.
limitation: Consumers may visit both marketplaces; canonical single-homing is best interpreted per shopping occasion.

exact_fact: Retail productivity depends on local footfall; more stores attract pedestrians and create positive shopping externalities.
limitation: Footfall is an agglomeration externality rather than a literal platform installed base.

source_title: Network Effects, Congestion Externalities, and Air Traffic Delays
exact_fact: Hub airports generate network benefits because clustered flights provide passengers with many connection opportunities; hubbing effects are empirically important.
limitation: Airline route choice mediates the relation between passenger volume and connectivity.

exact_fact: Hub status and performance are tied to network position, traffic concentration, transfer connectivity and operating capability.
limitation: Review does not directly estimate the candidate bilateral entry externality.

source_title: Regional dependence on foreign hubs / hub bypass
exact_fact: Regional airport hub-bypassing is documented as a way to develop new markets and reduce dependence on a central hub.
limitation: The bypass mechanism is route/network mediated rather than identical to the canonical one-sided utility equation.
